The passage discusses two types of hallucinations: command hallucinations and olfactory hallucinations. Command hallucinations are when a person hears voices telling them to do things, which can range from simple commands like "up" or "shut the door" to more threatening or harmful instructions. Olfactory hallucinations, on the other hand, are when a person smells something that isn't actually there.
